component.name: StreamMatrix
component.summary: High-performance video matrix viewer for live RTSP camera feeds

description.p: StreamMatrix is a lightweight, high-performance video matrix application designed for viewing and monitoring multiple live RTSP, RTMP, and HTTP video streams simultaneously.

ul.li: Optimized real-time H.264 decoding with multi-threaded slice acceleration
Customizable grid layouts with digital pan/zoom and preset cycling
Dual-profile sub-stream switching for low-bandwidth multi-camera monitoring
Automated reconnection watchdog for dropped or stalled feeds
Live stream diagnostics HUD (FPS, resolution, bitrate, codec)
Native Wayland and X11 display server support

description.p: Major under-the-hood RTSP streaming efficiency improvements for Raspberry Pi 5 and single-board computers (zero-alloc packet moves, lazy decoder threads, AVDISCARD_ALL muted audio skipping, automatic Pi 5 DRM hardware HEVC decoding with NEON unsand transfer, GUI video frame coalescing, and staggered grid startup), plus interactive Retry Now button and thread-safety fixes.

Added missing Debian 13 (Trixie) QML runtime and GTest dependencies, made GTest unit test compilation optional via BUILD_TESTING, added QML runtime dependencies to Debian package metadata, and refined documentation and changelog.
Added native Windows x86_64 support, portable ZIP and NSIS installer packaging, D3D11VA/DXVA2 hardware decoding support, and local file playback improvements.
RTSP socket teardown and 6s cooldown backoff for embedded RTSP servers, zero-overhead muted audio skipping, leaner Raspberry Pi 5 frame queues, and prevented background reconnects on hidden presets.
Restored automatic stream reconnection and watchdog recovery.
RTSP streaming optimizations for Raspberry Pi 5: active multi-threaded frame decoding, keyframe-aware packet queue, reduced latency backlog, and accelerated stream probing.
Interactive retry button confirmation, live reconnection status and countdowns, FFmpeg error diagnostics, and updated blue branding.
Flatpak and Flathub packaging, AppStream 1.0 metadata, and repository URL updates.
RTSP streaming stability improvements, non-blocking queue ring-buffer, multi-threaded NEON decoding, and reconnect watchdog.
